overview: A polished real-time task manager with project-based organization, smart filtering, keyboard shortcuts, drag-and-drop task reordering, inline editing, light/dark theming, and auto-save persistence.
features: Task list with title, description, due date, priority, and completion status
Collapsible sidebar for projects with task counts
Filtering by status, priority, due date, and search
Auto-save with 2-second debounce and Cmd/Ctrl+S manual save
Keyboard shortcuts: Cmd/Ctrl+N, S, D, Delete
Light/dark mode toggle persisted across sessions
Drag & drop to reorder tasks and move between projects
Subtasks, recurring tasks, tags/labels, and inline editing
